disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making, causing, or allowing a false entry or misstatement in any required book, record, or writing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person to knowingly make, cause, or allow to be made any false entry or misstatement of any material matter in any book, record, or writing required to be kept under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Receiving property from a person under age 18, under the influence of intoxicants or drugs, or known to have been convicted of burglary, robbery, theft, or receiving stolen property within the past 10 years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any pawnbroker or secondhand dealer to receive any property from any person under the age of eighteen years, any person under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs, or any person known to the pawnbroker or secondhand dealer as having been convicted of burglary, robbery, theft, or possession of or receiving stolen property within the past ten years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Removing, altering, or obliterating a manufacturer's serial number or identifying marks on personal property purchased, consigned, or received in pledge
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person to remove, alter, or obliterate any manufacturer's make, model, or serial number, personal identification number, or identifying marks engraved or etched upon an item of personal property that was purchased, consigned, or received in pledge

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pawnbroker engaging in check cashing or selling without complying with chapter 31.45 RCW
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any pawnbroker to engage in the business of cashing or selling checks, drafts, money orders, or other commercial paper serving the same purpose unless the pawnbroker complies with the provisions of chapter 31.45 RCW

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly violating any other provision of the chapter
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person to violate knowingly any other provision of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Secondhand precious metal dealer knowingly making a false entry in required precious metal transaction records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A secondhand precious metal dealer to knowingly make, cause, or allow to be made any false entry or misstatement of any material matter in any book, record, or writing required to be kept under RCW 19.60.025, 19.60.057, 19.60.042, 19.60.077, and 19.60.095 involving property consisting of precious metal

disciplinary_grounds.description: Secondhand precious metal dealer receiving precious metal from a person known to have been convicted of burglary, robbery, theft, or receiving stolen property within the past 10 years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A secondhand precious metal dealer to receive any precious metal property from any person known to the secondhand precious metal dealer as having been convicted of burglary, robbery, theft, or possession of or receiving stolen property within the past ten years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Secondhand precious metal dealer knowingly violating any other provision relating to precious metals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A secondhand precious metal dealer to knowingly violate any other provision relating to precious metals under RCW 19.60.025, 19.60.057, 19.60.042, 19.60.077, and 19.60.095.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: No person may operate as a pawnbroker unless the person maintains a fixed place of business within the state.

definition_quote.value: Secondhand dealer means every person engaged in whole or in part in the business of purchasing, selling, trading, consignment selling, or otherwise transferring for value, secondhand property including metal junk, melted metals, precious metals, whether or not the person maintains a fixed place of business within the state.
definition_quote.quote: "Secondhand dealer" means every person engaged in whole or in part in the business of purchasing, selling, trading, consignment selling, or otherwise transferring for value, secondhand property including metal junk, melted metals, precious metals, whether or not the person maintains a fixed place of business within the state.

methods_authorized.quote: purchasing, selling, trading, consignment selling, or otherwise transferring for value, secondhand property including metal junk, melted metals, precious metals

transaction_record_format.quote: shall maintain wherever that business is conducted a record in which shall be legibly written in the English language, at the time of each transaction

transaction_record_retention_years.quote: shall be maintained wherever that business is conducted, or at the secondhand dealer's principal place of business if the transaction took place through the use of an automated kiosk, for three years following the date of the transaction.

electronic_reporting_to_law_enforcement_.quote: This information may be transmitted to the applicable law enforcement agency electronically, by facsimile transmission, or by modem or similar device, or by delivery of computer disk subject to the requirements of, and approval by, the chief of police or the county's chief law enforcement officer.

reporting_frequency.quote: shall furnish a full, true, and correct transcript of the record of all transactions conducted on the preceding day

seller_ownership_statement_required.quote: The declaration must state substantially the following: "I, the undersigned, affirm under penalty of law that the property that is subject to this transaction is not to the best of my knowledge stolen property."

holding_period_days.quote: Property bought or received in pledge by any pawnbroker shall not be removed from that place of business, except when redeemed by, or returned to the owner, within thirty days after the receipt of the property.

law_enforcement_hold_order_authority.quote: Property held shall not be released for one hundred twenty days from the date of police notification unless released by written consent of the applicable law enforcement agency or by order of a court of competent jurisdiction.

automated_kiosk_holding_period_days.quote: Property bought by any secondhand dealer through the use of an automated kiosk must be held for at least thirty days after the secondhand property was accepted by the automated kiosk.

pawnbroker_interest_rate_cap.value: For loan amounts of $100.00 or more - interest at the rate of four percent for each thirty-day period to include the loan date; tiered schedule for amounts below $100
pawnbroker_interest_rate_cap.quote: For loan amounts of $100.00 or more - interest at the rate of four percent for each thirty-day period to include the loan date.

pawnbroker_minimum_loan_term_days.quote: The term of the loan shall be for a period of ninety days to include the date of the loan.

criminal_history_lookback_years.quote: any person known to the pawnbroker or secondhand dealer as having been convicted of burglary, robbery, theft, or possession of or receiving stolen property within the past ten years

exempt_seller_categories.quote: The provisions of this chapter do not apply to transactions conducted by the following: (1) Motor vehicle dealers licensed under chapter 46.70 RCW; (2) Vehicle wreckers, hulk haulers, and scrap processors licensed under chapter 46.79 or 46.80 RCW; (3) Persons giving an allowance for the trade-in or exchange of secondhand property on the purchase of other merchandise of the same kind of greater value; and (4) Persons in the business of buying or selling empty food and beverage containers or metal or nonmetal junk, in compliance with chapter 19.290 RCW.

minimum_holding_period_before_resale_day.quote: Property bought or received on consignment by any secondhand dealer with a permanent place of business in the state shall not be removed from that place of business except consigned property returned to the owner, within thirty days after the receipt of the property.
